# Submission Pack Structure — VCW403/SECURE/25 (Total Security Solution)

Assembly order follows the pack's own evaluation sequence: pre-qualifiers
first ("Bidders who do not adhere to those criteria listed below a
PRE-QUALIFIER will be disqualified immediately"), then responsiveness
documents, then the functionality returnable schedules with their evidence
attached in place — the pack's filing rule is explicit: "Functionality
Documentation must either be attached to the applicable Returnable Schedule
as stated below or can be bound into a separate volume and clearly
referenced … If the functionality document is not attached to the page or
clearly referenced it will be deemed not to have been included."

*(Documented for completeness — the recommendation on this tender is
NO-BID; this is what a compliant submission would have to look like.)*

## Envelope and logistics

- One **sealed envelope, clearly marked as instructed**: bid number
  **VCW403/SECURE/25**, description, closing date **2026-09-03 12:00**,
  bidder name and address.
- Deliver to Vaal Central Water, 02 Mzuzu Street, Pellissier, Bloemfontein
  before 12:00 — "Late submissions will not be considered"; public opening
  follows.
- Any address change during the tender must be notified to
  bids@vcwater.co.za.

## Volume 1 — Pre-qualification (order of the pre-qualifier table)

1. SBD 1 — Invitation to Bid (completed, signed)
2. SBD 3.1 — Pricing Schedule (firm prices) — every BoQ line for every
   region priced in full; "Non-submission or incomplete submission will
   result in disqualification"
3. SBD 4 — Bidder's Disclosure (completed, signed)
4. SBD 6.1 — Preference Points Claim (90/10 column; goals claimed with
   proof behind the form)
5. CIPC documents (certified) + certified ID copies of all directors
6. JV/Association agreement — N/A page (sole bid)
7. Municipal rates clearance certificate (original/certified) OR certified
   lease + lessor's municipal rates certificate — **not older than 3
   months** (VCW may physically verify the premises)
8. PSIRA registration certificate — company (certified)
9. PSIRA **Grade B** registration certificates — every director/member/
   partner/trustee (certified, one per listed individual)
10. COIDA Letter of Good Standing (certified)
11. PSSPF proof of payment — last 3 months
12. CIDB registration certificate, grading **4 SQ PE or higher** (Section 2
    bidders)
13. Public Liability Insurance certificate — minimum **R15 million**
14. Board of Directors resolution (signing authority)
15. Key staff PSIRA certificates (certified): Operations/Area Manager;
    Reaction Manager; Control Room Supervisor (Section 2); Technician —
    Electronic Security Systems (Section 2)

## Volume 2 — Responsiveness documents

16. SARS Tax Compliance Status PIN (per JV party where applicable)
17. **Full CSD report — not the summary**
18. Declaration of Interest (clean) + past-SCM/performance declarations
19. B-BBEE Compliance Certificate or Certified Sworn Affidavit
20. Acceptance of Bid conditions — completed and signed
21. Compulsory briefing attendance certificates — **per region bid**

## Volume 3 — Functionality returnable schedules (evidence attached to the page)

**Section 1 schedules, each with its proof stapled behind it:** security
equipment schedule; bank statements from 01 Feb 2026 (average balance) or
FSP funding letter; PSIRA confirmation letter of employee count;
supervisors list with PSIRA grades; vehicle schedule + registration
documents (7-vehicle proof ready for inspection); Grade A/B/C employment
contracts + 3 itemised payslips each (PSIRA sectoral salaries, COIDA, UIF,
provident, PSSBC); performance & attendance software ownership/licence;
uniform photographs (male & female, combat and step-out, company logo) +
current supplier PO/invoice; firearm permit book, competency certificates,
SABS safe certificate; locality proof (Free State/Northern Cape rates
clearance or lease ≤ 3 months).

**Section 2 schedules:** control-room address + distance to VCW Head
Office; control-room organogram; PSIRA letter for control-room staff;
Control Room Manager CV + NQF6 qualification; financial resource; locality
proof; last three perimeter-fencing projects (36 months) with completion
evidence.

## Volume 4 — Pricing

22. Priced Bills of Quantities per region (Free State Central, Northern
    Cape, etc.): guarding shifts, Performance & Attendance Management
    System, 2.4 m security + electric fencing (28,806 m), gates/turnstiles/
    motors/solar power, CCTV (bullet, APNR, PTZ, thermal), biometrics —
    every line priced (KILL-09); totals reconciled to SBD 1 and SBD 3.1;
    sanity-checked against the −20%/+20% tolerance band.

## Cross-checks before sealing

- Every certificate CERTIFIED where demanded, and fresh (3-month windows).
- Every functionality proof attached to its schedule page or referenced to
  a bound volume — unreferenced = "deemed not to have been included".
- Site-inspection readiness at the business address (4+ vehicles on hand,
  proof for 7; operational control room for Section 2) BEFORE submission —
  the inspection is unannounced.
- The generated SDK pack (`03-bid-pack.html`) is a transcription worksheet
  for the SBD forms only — Volumes 1–3 above are the hand-built remainder.
